blocks.text: These files were migrated from the former `/Users/richardtang/Documents/Proofpress` checkout, which is no longer maintained. They preserve the STALE/CUPMem condition contract, exploratory preregistration, and observed dataset profile. The source data hash and upstream commit were reverified in `upstream_lock.json`. The original two-record prompt-policy pilot is recorded in `pilot_report.json` as superseded because its execution boundaries were not matched; the production-style carrier implementation is documented in `../../docs/STALE_PHASE1_PLAN.md`. No held-out confirmatory efficacy matrix has been run.

The former two-arm local Codex pilot was intentionally not migrated as an executable runner. The current `run_pilot.py` is the exploratory adapter used for S0–S3; its CUPMem S1/S3 results use independent per-query checkpoints because the full-record adapter exceeded local memory limits. Those adapter limitations keep the result narrow and non-confirmatory.
